lots.title: Provision of Water Risk Assessments
lots.description: Provision of Water Risk Assessments services in Council Buildings for the London Borough of Bexley. Contract period is 1 September 2020 to 31 August 2022, subject to extension agreed pursuant to the terms of the Contract. This document is the draft Terms & Conditions (T&Cs) for Lot 2 of the 6278 Building Services Framework (Lots 1-11). The detailed Schedule 1 Specification that governs scope, assessor qualifications, deliverables and KPIs is referenced throughout but is not embedded within this document (Schedule 1 appears only as a section placeholder heading).
requirements: Provide Water Risk Assessment services in Council Buildings in accordance with the Specification (Schedule 1), the Code of Conduct at Appendix D to the ITT, and the General/Special Conditions of Contract (Clause B1.1).

Comply at all times with the Quality Standards (BSI British Standards Institution, ISO, or equivalent reputable body) and maintain accreditation with the relevant Quality Standards authorisation body where applicable (Clause B3.1).
Where a standard of Services is not specified, agree the relevant standard with the Council before supply and otherwise perform in accordance with the Law and Good Industry Practice (Clause B3.1).

Ensure all Staff supplying the Services possess the qualifications, skills and experience set out in the Specification and are competent, skilled, honest and experienced (Clauses B3.2, B4.2). Note: Clause B4.2 references 'fire risk assessors' and 'paragraph 3.12 of the Specification' which appears to be a template copy-paste retained from another lot; the analogous qualification clause for water risk assessors is expected in Schedule 1.

Provide all Equipment necessary for the supply of the Services; deliver Equipment to the Premises only with the Council's prior written approval; remove Equipment and materials on completion (Clauses B2.1-B2.6).
Register with the Disclosure and Barring Service and undertake DBS checks where required by the Specification; re-check at least every three years (Clauses B4.11-B4.13).
Maintain up-to-date personnel records and supply a list of Staff providing Services on request (Clause B4.4).
Appoint a suitably qualified, competent and English-fluent Contract Manager in full charge of performance of the Services and continuously available during specified operating hours (Clause B6.1).
Provide sufficient supervisory employees to ensure staff are supervised and comply with health-and-safety requirements (Clause B5.5).
Comply with the monitoring arrangements set out in the Specification including provision of Management Reports covering KPIs and matters referred to in the Specification (Clauses F7.1-F7.2).

Comply with KPIs included in Appendix E to the Invitation to Tender; Service Credits may be deducted for Service Failures (definitions of 'Key Performance Indicators', 'Service Credits', 'Service Failure'; Clauses C3A and F5).

Comply with all applicable health-and-safety Law including the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974; any chemicals/substances used must conform with relevant British or European standards and, for chemicals, have full HSE or Environment Agency approval (Clauses D6.1-D6.8, particularly D6.2, D6.7).

Observe the Council's environmental policy (Appendix C to the ITT) and Central Government environmental policy including energy/water/paper conservation and phase-out of ozone depleting substances (Clause D5.1).
Act as Processor under the Data Protection Legislation with the Council as Controller; process Personal Data only in accordance with Schedule 1 (Clauses E1.1-E1.15).
Maintain insurance sufficient to cover liabilities under the Contract; minimum insurance cover, if specified, is set out in the Specification or Special Conditions (Clause G1 and G1.10).
Comply with TUPE obligations on expiry/re-let, including supply of employee information to the Council within 21 days of request (Schedule-level Clauses S1.6-S1.7).
